summary.intent: Merge the docs PR for phases 56-58 roadmap/context, then kick off parallel work: plan phase 56 in a background worktree and write the phase 57 context document in the main thread.
summary.outcome: Docs PR #539 was opened and merged (squash) to main. Phase 56 plan was spawned in an isolated git worktree via a background agent. Phase 57 CONTEXT.md and DISCUSSION-LOG.md were written and committed on a clean branch, with no open design decisions remaining.

repo: CIDv1 is actively used in the system (`cid-version=1` on Kubo add); `UnpinDto.CID_REGEX` already covers both v0 (`Qm...{44}`) and v1 (`b[a-z2-7]{58,}`) — phase 57's fix is to extract that regex + `@MaxLength(255)` onto `RegisterCidDto` and tighten `{44,}` → `{44}`.
The concurrency primitive for phase 57 is `pg_advisory_xact_lock` already in place from Phase 50; `withCidLock` is a consolidation wrapper, not a new design choice.
The `Cargo.lock` drift (cipherbox-fuse 0.6.1→0.7.0, cipherbox-sdk 0.6.0→0.7.0) is pre-existing release-version churn unrelated to docs/planning work — must be excluded from docs PRs explicitly.

Phase 57 scope: extract shared CID regex, URL-encode CIDs, leaf `IpfsProviderModule`, consolidate `pg_advisory_xact_lock` — all directions locked from ROADMAP + 4 folded todos in `.planning/phases/57-*/pending/`.
workflow: Background agents can now nest subagents (harness supports it) — the earlier caveat about plan-checker not running in background worktrees is no longer valid.
When a docs branch is an ancestor of the current HEAD, it can be fast-forwarded to include newer commits before pushing, keeping PR scope clean.
Phase 57 branch was created off the roadmap commit (not current HEAD) to isolate it from phase-56 context commits and avoid polluting PR #539.
Parallel flow: background worktree agent for phase 56 plan + inline main-thread work for phase 57 context — branches are non-overlapping so no file conflicts.

friction: GSD's auto-branch-switch moved the working branch from `docs/planning-20260621` to `feat/fuse-and-ipns-durability-hardening` unexpectedly, requiring extra git archaeology to recover the correct source branch for the docs PR.

Phase 57 branch had to be carved off a specific roadmap commit (not main, not HEAD) because the roadmap only existed in PR #539 pre-merge — required careful ordering and an isolated branch to avoid polluting the open PR.
The `Cargo.lock` out-of-scope drift was a persistent noise item that had to be actively excluded at every git operation.
